canonical_project: Project Sail / Atlas Development–Prologis Coweta campus
aliases: Project Sail / Atlas Development–Prologis Coweta campus

location.roads_or_area: Welcome to Sargent Road and Wagers Mill Road / rural Sargent area

status_as_of_cutoff: Approved-permitted / pre-construction: Coweta County Board of Commissioners approved rezoning petition REZ 24-19 for Project Sail on 2026-04-07 by a reported 3-2 vote, but no verified building permit, certificate of occupancy, energized load, construction start, or tenant identity was located. Litigation seeking to void the rezoning was reported filed in Coweta County Superior Court on 2026-05-05. DRI #4361 remains a regional-review record, not the local approval itself.

actions.government_body: Georgia Department of Community Affairs / regional DRI process
actions.result_status: Phase 2 and contemporaneous reporting identify a late-December DRI filing for the proposed 13-building Coweta campus. The underlying project DRI packet and local approval were not located in an accessible official record.
actions.access_caveat: The primary accessible evidence for the filing was specialist reporting; DCA states DRI is not a regulatory approval and local government retains final authority.
actions.evidence_note: Reported DRI filing; not a rezoning, permit, vote, or construction start.

actions.government_body: Not a government action; specialist report
actions.result_status: Report described the 832-acre, 13-building, approximately $17 billion proposal and identified Atlas as sponsor at that time; later sponsor naming and scale metrics are not reconciled into one official approval record.
actions.access_caveat: Press/discovery source only; no vote is inferred.

actions.result_status: Developer site continued to describe the Coweta campus and infrastructure commitments; no public permit, executed development agreement, tenant, energization, or commissioning record was exposed.
actions.access_caveat: Company/developer source; not a county or city approval.
actions.evidence_note: Company announcement kept separate from land-use and building approvals.

actions.result_status: Approved with conditions, reported 3-2 vote, rezoning approximately 829 acres off Welcome to Sargent Road and Wagers Mill Road from Rural Conservation to Industrial for a nine-building Project Sail data-center campus.
actions.access_caveat: CivicClerk official public portal is JavaScript-rendered; search-indexed agenda text identifies the petition and DRI attachments. FOX 5, DCD, AJC, and The Citizen corroborate the vote and outcome from county records.
actions.evidence_note: Rezoning approval with conditions; not evidence of vertical construction, certificate of occupancy, energized load, or tenant occupancy.

actions.result_status: Local residents reportedly filed a Petition for Review/Appeal and Request for Declaratory Judgment against Coweta County and Atlas Development LLC seeking to void the rezoning approval and prohibit construction/operation.
actions.access_caveat: Local media report; court docket record was not independently retrieved in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Pending litigation risk; allegations are not findings.

actions.result_status: County staff and commissioners discussed proposed amendments to the Coweta County Data Center Ordinance, including removing conditional use from Light Industrial, limiting data centers as conditional uses in Industrial, noise, onsite generation, buffers, developer community meetings, pre-application noise studies, separate fees, and third-party inspections.
actions.vote_tally: work session / no final vote in recap
actions.access_caveat: County recap describes ordinance direction generally and does not name Project Sail.
actions.evidence_note: Regulatory-context update; not a project approval or construction milestone.

owner: Atlas Development, LLC / Prologis (developer/applicant relationship; Prologis site acquisition/ownership not fully verified in public records)

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.topic: current campus scale and electrical capacity
contradictions.details: Official DCA DRI #4361 initial materials list 13 buildings of about 378,000 SF each and no disclosed peak electrical load; current developer site says the plan was reduced to 9 buildings and 4.34 million SF; DCD and FOX 5 report about 900 MW, while other advocacy/secondary references cite 910 MW or older 936 MW figures.

DCA DRI records identify Atlas Development, LLC as developer/applicant; current project website and multiple reports associate Prologis with the campus; DCD reported on 2026-04-10 that Prologis had not yet closed on the site transaction.

history.value: Large proposed campus with DRI/utility-planning and developer-site evidence, but no verified groundbreaking, building permit, certificate of occupancy, energized load, or tenant identity was located. DRI is a regional communication process, not the local approval itself.
